title: ORDER BY accepts an expression computed for each row of the result
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Product, "Product", Product[Product], "Price", Product[Price] ) ORDER BY [Price] * -1

source.quote: Any expression that can be evaluated for each row of the result is valid.
source.supports: ORDER BY takes an expression over the result columns

source.quote: It can include only columns that are part of EVALUATE or expressions that can be computed in the row context of the result.
source.supports: ORDER BY takes an expression over the result columns

derivation: The sort key is the price negated: -100 (Bike), -50 (Scooter), -20 (Helmet), -10 (Lock), ascending.
